name: Parmesan-Corn Fritters with Spinach, Avocado & Roasted Pepper Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry, then transfer to a large bowl.
Add eggs, cheese, flour, and spices to the bowl with the corn. Stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
1 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a large paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a clean large bowl.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the spinach.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Add to the bowl along with vinaigrette, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers
⅓ cup French vinaigrette
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fritters and salad between plates. Enjoy!
